policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Meta introduced its Muse Glimmer AI model and plans to release Muse Spark 1.2 weights, indicating a push for open-source AI development to compete with other major AI firms.
Ford is rolling out a new AI-powered assistant for its Ford and Lincoln mobile apps, enabling users to check vehicle information such as fuel levels and tire pressure through conversational queries.
Docker has introduced Docker Sandboxes, providing disposable and isolated environments designed for the development and testing of AI agents.

world.summary: Ukraine confirmed extensive drone strikes targeting oil refineries and industrial facilities deep within Russia's Tatarstan region, an attack that Russian officials stated killed at least 13 people and injured 75 others.
Taiwan conducted military drills to prepare for a potential invasion from China, with the exercises designed to enhance the island's defensive capabilities.

especially in Western Europe, where June and July were also declared the hottest on record.
